responsibility: Contains the grammar and semantic actions used to generate the hidden-type resolution parser pass. This pass reparses source after earlier declaration work in order to resolve hidden or opaque type details while simultaneously emitting the associated file/module/procedure quad boundaries and executable constructs needed for that specialized pass context.
same_name_distinction: This is the generated grammar and semantic-action implementation for the hidden-type pass; unlike PHBuild.def, which only declares the parser entry point, it contains the parser rules and actions that combine hidden-type resolution with selected quad-building hooks.
